12-06.morning: My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive; and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.
12-06.evening: Thrived a bit today? Lovely. Now survive the commute and thrive on the sofa.

12-07.morning: Wrap up loose ends before they wrap up you.
12-07.evening: Loose ends tied. Gift-wrapping skills: still questionable. Go home.

12-08.morning: Keep going. The finish line has better snacks.
12-08.evening: Today's finish line reached. Snack accordingly.

12-09.morning: Cosy weather is no excuse for cosy goals. Aim high, sip something warm.
12-09.evening: Something warm to drink, something kind to think. That's the evening sorted.

12-10.morning: Hold the door, share the credit, keep the good vibes going.
12-10.evening: Good vibes delivered all day. Time to deliver yourself home.

12-11.morning: One focused hour beats three distracted ones.
12-11.evening: Focus mode: off. Family mode: on.

12-12.morning: The year is ending, but your story isn't. Write a good paragraph today.
12-12.evening: Good paragraph today. Bookmark it and go home.

12-13.morning: Be the person your calendar is lucky to have.
12-13.evening: Calendar's clear for the rest of today. Notice that? It's called freedom.

12-14.morning: Ideas love walks. Take one if you're stuck.
12-14.evening: A quick walk after dinner tonight? Your step counter will be thrilled.

12-15.morning: Plant a seed today that next year can water.
12-15.evening: Seeds planted. Let them sleep; you should too.

12-16.morning: Shine like the festive lights — steady, warm, a little bit extra. ✨
12-16.evening: Lights on outside, laptop off inside. Perfect evening balance.

12-17.morning: Clear the inbox, clear the mind. Or at least clear the coffee mug.
12-17.evening: Mug washed? Desk tidied? Splendid. Your shift is over.

12-18.morning: A good attitude is the best accessory of the season.
12-18.evening: The season's best accessory: comfy pyjamas. Go put them on.

12-19.morning: Finish one thing you've been avoiding. Watch the relief roll in.
12-19.evening: That avoided task? If it's done, celebrate. If not, it'll be there tomorrow, sulking.

12-20.morning: Fewer worries, more wonder. Season's orders.
12-20.evening: Wonder tip: look up at the sky on your way home tonight.

12-21.morning: The shortest day still has room for a great idea.
12-21.evening: Short day, long to-do list — and you still made it. Go home.

12-22.morning: Celebrate small wins today. Big ones are made of them.
12-22.evening: Hydration check before you leave: one glass of water, then home. 💧

12-23.morning: Even the year-end rush runs smoother with one calm, kind person in it. Be that person.
12-23.evening: The rush is out there; the calm is at home. Head towards the calm.

12-24.morning: Wrap your work up like a present — neatly, with a little bow on top. 🎁
12-24.evening: Work wrapped, bow on. Time to unwrap a relaxed evening.

12-25.morning: Joy is a renewable resource. Use plenty today.
12-25.evening: Whatever today held, may your evening be warm, full and unhurried.

12-26.morning: Rest isn't a reward for finishing — it's how you finish well.
12-26.evening: Easy evening ahead. You've earned an unplanned one.

12-27.morning: Note one lesson this year taught you. That's free wisdom.
12-27.evening: Lesson of the day: stopping on time is a skill too.

12-28.morning: Plan next year in pencil. Dreams need room to grow.
12-28.evening: Next year's plans can simmer. Tonight's plan is simpler: rest.

12-29.morning: Be proud of what you carried this year, not just what you completed.
12-29.evening: Put down everything you carried today. It's lighter at home.

12-30.morning: Thank someone today who made your year easier.
12-30.evening: A thank-you sent today echoes for weeks. Good work — now go rest.

12-31.morning: Last page of the year. Make it a happy ending — and a great cliffhanger.
12-31.evening: Year: complete. You: wonderful. See you on the other side. 🎉
